components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-contrast action button with vibrant royal sky gradient and arrow micro-interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #164AC7 0%, #1E6BFF 55%, #0099FF 100%); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Lexend', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(30,107,255,0.45); transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1.5px); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -4px rgba(30,107,255,0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-arrow { font-weight: 700; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F5AB1D 0%, #E59A0F 100%); color: #0D1B3E; font-family: 'Lexend', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(245,171,29,0.35); transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-1.5px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(245,171,29,0.45); } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

narrative.overview: BasaWisyo pairs the warmth, civic pride, and optimism of Philippine community reading rooms with the tactile precision of world-class edtech. Designed specifically for Filipino learners and DepEd educators, the interface is bright, welcoming, and purposeful—encouraging regular literacy practice without childish clutter, aggressive dark patterns, or cold corporate SaaS sterility.
keyCharacteristics: Warm & Civic: DepEd-aligned civic palette grounded in deep navy, sunlit gold, and royal sky blue.
Tactile & Responsive: Generous squircle geometry (10px–24px), distinct :active press scale (0.98), and soft ambient hover lighting.
Fluency-Optimized: Typographic hierarchy anchored by Lexend to scientifically maximize letter distinction.
Offline Integrity: Zero visual reliance on external network assets; crisp SVG vector iconography and instant local feedback.

rules.name: The Civic Harmony Rule
rules.body: Screens must respect a 60-30-10 distribution: 60% neutral canvas/card ground (#F3F6FC / #FFFFFF), 30% structural navy typography (#0D1B3E), and 10% purposeful royal sky accent (#1A73E8). Sunlit Gold (#F5AB1D) is strictly an earned reward accent and must never be used for generic interface buttons.

rules.name: The Fluency-First Rule
rules.body: Lexend is sacred for all student reading surfaces, questions, and feedback. Passage text must never drop below 1rem (16px) with line-height at or above 1.6. Bricolage Grotesque is strictly forbidden from body copy and quiz answers.

rules.name: The Ambient Response Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces remain flat and clean. Shadows and ambient glows are earned strictly through state changes (hover, focus, active press, or modal foregrounding).

dos: Do use Lexend at minimum 16px (1rem) and line-height 1.6 for all reading passages and quiz questions.
Do provide immediate offline feedback (soundless visual confirmation or gentle pulse) for all learning actions.
Do maintain a minimum 44px by 44px touch target size for every button, chip, and choice option.
Do anchor cards with 1px solid #D5E0F2 to guarantee high contrast on varied classroom monitors.
Do celebrate reading milestones with Wisyo the Owl mascot and Sunlit Gold accents.
donts: Don't use cold corporate grays (#64748B / #334155) for primary backgrounds; always maintain the warm sky tint (#F3F6FC).
Don't use Bricolage Grotesque inside reading text, paragraph copy, or quiz answers.
Don't build features that require online server calls without providing a 100% functional offline fallback.
Don't hide or obscure teacher classroom share codes behind complex navigation menus.
Don't introduce distracting flashing animations, autoplay audio, or anxiety-inducing countdown timers on diagnostic reading assessments.
